entries.definition: the shared ways of life and ideas of a group
entries.example: Food can introduce visitors to part of a culture.

entries.definition: a practice passed from one generation to another
entries.example: Our family has a tradition of cooking together on holidays.

entries.definition: a usual way of behaving in a community
entries.example: The guide explained a local custom about greeting guests.

entries.definition: people connected by a place or shared interest
entries.example: The community worked together to reopen the playground.

entries.definition: a person living near you
entries.example: Our neighbor checks the plants when we travel.

entries.definition: someone who offers work without being required or paid
entries.example: A volunteer helped visitors find the correct room.

entries.definition: an organization that helps people or causes in need
entries.example: The charity collects warm clothes for families who request them.

entries.definition: something given to support a person or cause
entries.example: The small donation helped buy books for the reading room.

entries.definition: a planned occasion or important happening
entries.example: The event brought together people from several neighborhoods.

entries.definition: an organized celebration often involving cultural activities
entries.example: The festival includes music, stories, and local food.

entries.definition: to mark a happy or important occasion
entries.example: We will celebrate the library’s reopening on Friday.

entries.definition: open or available to people generally
entries.example: The public garden is open until sunset.

entries.definition: intended for a particular person or limited group
entries.example: The meeting concerns a private family matter.

entries.definition: a legally recognized member of a country
entries.example: Each citizen has rights and responsibilities under the law.

entries.definition: someone who lives in a particular place
entries.example: Every resident received information about the water repair.

entries.definition: someone spending time in a place without living there
entries.example: The visitor asked where she could leave her coat.

entries.definition: all the people living in a particular area
entries.example: The report describes changes in the town’s population.

entries.definition: the group responsible for running a country or region
entries.example: The government published information about the new service.

entries.definition: an official rule enforced by public authority
entries.example: The new law concerns safety in public buildings.

entries.definition: an instruction stating what is allowed or required
entries.example: One rule of the club is to listen respectfully.

entries.definition: a freedom or protection someone is entitled to
entries.example: The sign explains your right to request information.

entries.definition: the ability to act or express yourself without unfair limits
entries.example: The discussion focused on freedom of expression.

entries.definition: giving the same opportunity or status to everyone concerned
entries.example: Every student should have an equal chance to participate.

entries.definition: treating people honestly and without unjust advantage
entries.example: We need a fair way to share the available space.

entries.definition: treating someone in a way that is not just
entries.example: The team thought the sudden change was unfair.

entries.definition: care and consideration for another person’s worth or rights
entries.example: Listening without laughing shows respect for a new speaker.

entries.definition: belief that someone is honest or dependable
entries.example: Keeping small promises can help build trust.

entries.definition: help given to someone facing a need or difficulty
entries.example: The new learners appreciated the group’s patient support.

entries.definition: to work together toward a shared purpose
entries.example: The two clubs agreed to cooperate on the cleanup.

entries.definition: to feel accepted as part of a group
entries.example: A friendly welcome can help newcomers feel they belong.

entries.definition: to make someone or something part of a group
entries.example: Please include the evening staff in the discussion.

entries.definition: to keep someone or something out of a group
entries.example: A high fee may exclude people with limited money.

entries.definition: to take part in an activity
entries.example: Everyone can participate even without previous experience.

entries.definition: to express a formal choice in a decision
entries.example: Members will vote on the opening hours next week.

entries.definition: a person who guides or directs a group
entries.example: A good leader asks questions as well as giving directions.

entries.definition: a person belonging to a group or organization
entries.example: Each member may suggest one activity for the month.

entries.definition: people watching or listening to a performance or talk
entries.example: The audience waited quietly while the student found her notes.

entries.definition: a large group of people gathered in one place
entries.example: The crowd moved slowly through the narrow entrance.

entries.definition: relating to towns or cities
entries.example: The exhibition compares urban and village life.

entries.definition: relating to the countryside
entries.example: The rural clinic serves several small villages.

entries.definition: systems and means used to move people or goods
entries.example: Reliable transportation helps students reach evening classes.

entries.definition: vehicles moving along roads
entries.example: Heavy traffic delayed the morning bus.

entries.definition: a person traveling on foot
entries.example: The driver stopped to let a pedestrian cross.

entries.definition: someone traveling in a vehicle without driving it
entries.example: One passenger offered her seat to an older traveler.

entries.definition: an act of traveling from one place to another
entries.example: The journey to the village takes most of the morning.

entries.definition: the place someone is traveling to
entries.example: Write your destination clearly on the travel form.

entries.definition: the line separating two countries or regions
entries.example: The map shows the border running along the river.

entries.definition: an official document used for international travel
entries.example: Keep your passport in a safe place while traveling.

entries.definition: who a person is or the qualities defining them
entries.example: The library asks for proof of identity when issuing a card.

entries.definition: a shared decision or arrangement accepted by those involved
entries.example: The two groups reached an agreement about using the hall.
